name: forest_battle_3hetake
doc: Stands in for saves/battle_re/forest_battle_3hetake.state: in Guardia Forest (loc 013) Crono walks north-west to the second group of 'mushroom' bushes (objects 21-23, the scene's var $0B -> obj 1's D8 02 00) and walks into the lowest one; the three Hetake jump out and the battle starts. 300 frames later Crono's command menu is up (Marle's not yet), HP 70/65 as the reference.
